Every unique document in the filtered-sources collection, annotated against a fixed codebook: genre, jurisdiction, lifecycle status, embodied-AI taxonomy, governance topics, principles and mechanisms. Filters scope the tiles, the charts and the table together. Click a row for the full record.

Relevance is the annotator's 0 to 3 rating of how central embodied-AI governance is to the document. Year is the annotated publication or adoption date, falling back to OpenAlex, then PDF metadata. Jurisdiction region follows the issuing jurisdiction or first author's affiliation, so it can differ from the folder a document was collected under. Unusable captures (bot walls, scanned PDFs) are kept with page quality marked.
